item.title: Davis Farmers Market — Sat Sep 19, 8:00 AM — Central Park
item.description:
Year-round at Central Park in downtown Davis, thousands gather each week to shop for what is grown, raised, and made locally at our markets. We are dedicated to bringing farmers right to your table, so we stay open rain or shine. Walk rows of stalls lined with an array of fruits and vegetables, including certified organic produce, choice meats, chicken, seafood, wine, local eggs and honey. Choose from a variety of fresh-baked goods, plants, flowers and gifts. Enjoy a picnic from one of our many food stands, made from market ingredients. See the vendor list here: https://www.davisfarmersmarket.org/our-sellers/ Farmers Market Hours Central Park: Saturdays 8a–1p (year-round), and Wednesdays 3p–6p (September through March); 4p–8p (April through August) UC Davis – North Quad: Wednesdays 10a–1:30p (fall and spring quarters) Sutter Davis Hospital: Thursdays 10a–1p (May through September) Sutter Medical Center, Sacramento: Thursdays 2:30p–5:30p
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Make Your Own Leather Bracers! — Sat Sep 19, 10:00 AM — Davis Arts Center
item.description:
Get ready for Halloween or Renfair by making your own bracers! In this two-day beginner workshop, you’ll learn the leather making process, from cutting and shaping the leather to setting hardware, stamping, and dyeing. Wow your friends and elevate your costumes with your own custom bracers! No prior experience needed. Beginners are welcome! Children under 13 must be accompanied by an adult All materials included Instructor: Percy (He/They) ALL AGES Price: $70 Time: 10:00 am-12:00 pm Workshop date: Saturdays, September 12 & 19
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Griefball weekend camp x Sacramento Kings — Sat Sep 19, 11:30 AM
item.description:
Griefball Uses Basketball to Address Grief and Mental Health Among Teen Boys The Center for Loss & Hope at YoloCares is launching Griefball, an innovative two-day weekend camp that combines basketball with somatic grief practices to help boys and young men, ages 7-25, who have experienced the death of a loved one. Hosted in collaboration with the Sacramento Kings, Griefball brings together Jr. Kings coaches, grief specialists, and trained volunteers to address the growing mental health challenges facing boys and young men.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Grounded Together: Building Resilience, Connection, and Community — Wed Sep 23, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community ***P.S. this is part of a 5 week series, though not required, you are highly encouraged to attend all - No meeting on Oct 7***
Join **Rev. Rola Al-Ashkar** for a five-week journey exploring how our life experiences shape the way we respond to stress, conflict, belonging, and relationships. Through storytelling, guided reflection, and gentle body-centered (somatic) practices, participants will develop tools for greater self-awareness, emotional resilience, and compassionate listening. Whether you're seeking personal growth, healthier relationships, or a deeper sense of connection within our community, this series offers a welcoming and supportive space. No prior experience is necessary. Please register using the following link: [[LINK](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxWVImvnFcRLw5on8gH2WFGQfoMnVmNowpxZd9FHajblr2Iw/viewform?usp=send_form)]. **Wednesdays:** Sept. 16, 23, 30; Oct. 14 & 21 6:00 – 8:00 pm
Source: Meetup: Mindful Embodied Spirituality

item.title: Free Yoga Practice — Thu Oct 1, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community 🌀 **Move with intention. Connect with your body. Celebrate community.**
Join us every **Thursday at 6 PM** for an embodied yoga practice designed to help you release tension, ground yourself, and cultivate presence. This is a trauma-informed, all-levels class, no prior yoga experience needed. Expect a Hatha-Vinyasa flow, breathwork, and a space to listen to your body’s wisdom.
🌿 **Every last Thursday of the month, stay after class for a community potluck dinner!**
📍 **Location**: 727 T St. Sacramento CA 95811 ✨ **All our events are free. Donations are welcome.** 📩 **Questions? Reach out at** embody.iama@gmail.com 🔗 **Follow us on Instagram:** [@embody.iama](https://www.instagram.com/embody.iama)
Source: Meetup: Mindful Embodied Spirituality

item.title: Blood on the Clocktower at Blue Note — Wed Oct 7, 5:00 PM
item.description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering The first Wednesday of every month, we play _Blood on the Clocktower_, a social deduction game in the vein of Werewolf/Mafia/The Resistance, with a few twists!
We'll have a circle of chairs reserved inside Blue Note, near the back, with a Yolo County Board Game Gathering sign on the table. Just say hello, and we'll show you some games, pull some players together, and get to having fun!
We also usually have a few tables of players playing other board games, if social deduction isn't your bag!
Get a feel for Blood on the Clocktower here: https://youtu.be/4sfa8_kNxsQ
Source: Meetup: Yolo Board Game Gathering

item.title: Davis Waldorf School's Parent & Child Class — Fri Sep 18, 10:00 AM — Davis Waldorf School
item.description:
The first three years in a child’s life are an amazing time of growth that fill parents and caregivers with awe and wonder. Parent & Child classes are held in a warm and welcoming environment that is carefully arranged for creative play in our Buttercup Preschool room. This program offers the very young child freedom to explore within loving boundaries, and teaches parents/caregivers about Waldorf education’s many benefits. Classes are led by an experienced Early Childhood educator and echo the rhythms of the Waldorf preschool. Additionally, classes offer caregivers a place to connect about child development and parenting techniques. We welcome caregivers of all kinds—parents, grandparents, nannies—to join our sessions!
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Sweet Peas Parent Pod — Fri Sep 18, 11:30 AM — SwimAmerica-Davis
item.description: Name of Group: Parent Pod Sweet Peas Parent Pod Time: Fridays @ 11:30am – 12:30pm Description: This FREE support group is for EVERY type of parent and offers a unique opportunity to connect with others who are on the same journey. You’ll have the chance to share experiences, offer advice, and find support during this special time. item.title: Hot & Bothered (Sex, Menopause and Mocktails) — Fri Sep 18, 6:30 PM — 1550 Cannery Ave
item.description:
Join us for an intimate evening of mocktails, delicious bites, and honest conversation about one of the least talked-about parts of midlife: sex and intimacy during menopause. Whether you’re experiencing changes in desire, discomfort with sex, shifts in your relationship, or simply wondering “Is this normal?” you’re not alone. Together, we’ll explore how menopause affects our bodies, brains, and relationships, bust common myths, discuss evidence-based treatment options, and reimagine what intimacy can look like in this stage of life. You’ll leave feeling informed, empowered, and hopeful, with practical tools and resources you can actually use. More info and sign-up here: https://tocarrywonder.com/events-perimenopause-menopause/

She confides in her father and begs him not to tell her mother. Now, Gomez Addams must do something he’s never done before– keep a secret from his beloved wife, Morticia.
